convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call 'WPR Custom' custom indicator which is a custom implementation of Williams Percent Range with configurable levels. Trading logic itself is simple but depends on external .mqh includes (Trade library, MoneyFixedMargin) and a custom indicator that must be replicated.

indicators.name: WPR Custom (Williams Percent Range with custom levels)

derived_values.name: WPR buffer value at bar InpBarCurrent
digits_adjust (multiplier for 3/5 digit brokers)
derived_values.used_by: CMoneyFixedMargin initialization and SL/TP point adjustment

other_exits: When no position exists and opposite signal fires, closes opposite-side positions before opening new one via ClosePositions() then resetting PrevBars to force next-bar re-entry

position_sizing.conditional_logic: IntLotOrRisk==lot: use fixed lot InpVolumeLorOrRisk (default 1.0). IntLotOrRisk==risk: use CMoneyFixedMargin with Percent=InpVolumeLorOrRisk (default 1.0) to calculate lot from free margin and risk percent. Risk default input is 5 but InpVolumeLorOrRisk (1.0) is the actual value passed to money manager.

custom_logic_notes: EA uses OnTradeTransaction to track last closed position type (m_last_position_type) but this value is never used in trading decisions. The PrevBars=0 reset after closing opposite positions forces immediate re-evaluation on next tick. WPR custom indicator is a standard WPR calculation with configurable level lines and visual customization - functionally equivalent to built-in iWPR but loaded via iCustom. Entry checks WPR value at bar index InpBarCurrent (default=1, i.e. last completed bar). No SL or TP are set (both passed as 0.0). Reversal logic: if a position exists and opposite signal fires, it closes the existing position but does NOT open a new one on same bar (PrevBars=0 forces wait for next bar).
python_conversion_notes: The WPR Custom indicator is functionally identical to standard WPR (ta.momentum.WilliamsR in pandas_ta, or manual calculation from High/Low/Close over period). The entry logic is simple level-based: BUY when WPR < -75 (oversold), SELL when WPR > -25 (overbought). No SL/TP means positions are held until signal reversal. The conditional lot sizing needs two paths: fixed lot or margin-based percentage sizing. The CMoneyFixedMargin class calculates lot size as: lot = (FreeMargin * Percent / 100) / (Margin_per_lot). The new-bar guard and position check are straightforward. Key detail: InpBarCurrent=1 means signal is evaluated on the last completed bar (index 1), not the forming bar (index 0). The digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 3/5 digit brokers) only affects the money manager init, not SL/TP since those are 0.
